user_query: trass gmail and stories about pradip

intent.goal: find emails and stories related to Pradip in the Trass workspace

generated_query:
SELECT DISTINCT
    u.page_id,
    u.workspace, 
    u.database_name,
    u.title,
    u.created_time,
    COALESCE(g.subject, '') as subject,
    COALESCE(g.sender_name, '') as sender_name,
    COALESCE(g.sender_email, '') as sender_email,
    COALESCE(g.body_snippet, '') as snippet
FROM unified_content u
LEFT JOIN gmail_content g ON u.page_id = g.page_id
WHERE u.workspace IN ('trass')
AND u.database_name IN ('gmail', 'stories')
AND (
    LOWER(u.title) LIKE '%pradip%'
    OR LOWER(COALESCE(g.subject,'')) LIKE '%pradip%'
    OR LOWER(COALESCE(g.sender_name,'')) LIKE '%pradip%'
    OR LOWER(COALESCE(g.sender_email,'')) LIKE '%pradip%'
    OR LOWER(COALESCE(g.body_snippet,'')) LIKE '%pradip%'
    OR LOWER(COALESCE(g.message_content,'')) LIKE '%pradip%'
)
ORDER BY u.created_time DESC
LIMIT 1200
